parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Part two. You will hear a teacher giving a talk about a junior school to a group of parents. First, you will have some time to look at questions eleven to seventeen.

Now listen carefully and answer questions eleven to seventeen.

Okay, can everybody hear me? Good. Well, I'd like to welcome all the new parents to Springdown Junior School. My name is Anne Rawson, and I'm the assistant head teacher.

What I'd like to do is tell you about the school day and show you around the school, and perhaps you can ask me any questions you may have at the end. Right. First of all, let me start by telling you a little bit about what happens here and what's on offer.

Children are expected to arrive at school between eight forty-five and eight fifty, and the bell is rung for everybody to go to their classrooms at eight fifty-five so that we can take the register.

We then have assembly at nine o'clock when the whole school meets in the hall for the head to talk to the children. He may discuss what's happened in the news or something that is important for the school.

Lessons run until four PM with an hour for lunch.

Lunch is served in the canteen, and children can bring their own packed lunch or a hot meal is available.

They also have time to play outside and get some fresh air.

In the middle of the morning and the middle of the afternoon, there are two breaks of fifteen minutes when the children also generally go outside, unless it's wet.

Now, we encourage the children to do as much as they can, and we offer them several ways of achieving this. For example, on Thursday afternoons, rather than continuing with lessons, we expect the whole school to do sports.

We vary these between summer and winter, and everything is supervised by the teachers.

Also, we like the children to work on something artistic over a long period of time. So for each of the three terms, they are expected to produce a poster. This will normally be on something particular that they have studied that term, such as the environment.

We also make sure we keep a close eye on how each child is doing in their schoolwork. And every month, rather than the teacher giving the children a report, as I know some schools do, they have to do tests, and we record their performance over the year.

We're very proud of our school and of the very good results we achieve. Our teachers are all very committed to the school. And at the end of the school day, many of them have set up clubs that the children go to for an extra hour to learn a new skill, such as music.

Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions eighteen to twenty on page four.

Now listen and answer questions eighteen to twenty.

Okay, I'll quickly show you where everything is.

We're here at the main entrance and on the right, where you would normally expect to find reception, you'll see the head's office.

He likes to see visitors personally, and his door is always open.

Opposite this are two of the classrooms, but most of the classrooms are down the long corridor.

The library then is situated between those two classrooms, and we are hoping that we will be able to create a computer room within that so that the children can have somewhere quiet to work on their own.

On the left of the classrooms, we have converted one of the old cloak rooms to create a music room, and children can go in there at lunchtime if they want to.

Now, if you come with me through the main hall here.

Okay. Now, as you can probably see, this main hall is a new addition this year, and we are very pleased with it.

We used to be squashed into the old assembly hall next door, which, as you can see, has now been turned into a gym for the children, and we have weekly lessons here.

Do feel free to go and look around the classrooms, and I'll be waiting here to answer your questions.

That is the end of part two. You now have forty-five seconds to check your answers to part two.

analyses.content: 录音明确提到打铃让大家回教室点名（take the register对应registration）的时间是8点55分。
你可能会听到8:45或8:50，但那是预计到校的时间，而不是正式打铃开始点名的时间。
Children are expected to arrive at school between eight forty-five and eight fifty, and the bell is rung for everybody to go to their classrooms at eight fifty-five so that we can take the register.
录音说明除了学生可以自带午餐，食堂也会提供热餐（hot meal）。
你可能会填入干扰信息packed lunch，但那是学生自己带的，并不是学校食堂提供的选项。
Lunch is served in the canteen, and children can bring their own packed lunch or a hot meal is available.
录音直接提到上午和下午各有一次15分钟的休息时间（breaks of fifteen minutes）。
你可能会在听到fifteen时出现拼写失误，或者只顾着听后面的go outside而漏掉表示时间的数字。
In the middle of the morning and the middle of the afternoon, there are two breaks of fifteen minutes when the children also generally go outside, unless it's wet.
录音提到在周四下午，学校期望全校学生（the whole school对应题目中的all children）都去做运动（do sports对应take part in sports）。
你可能会听到lessons这个词并填入，但录音说的是“而不是继续上课（rather than continuing with lessons）”，必须排除这个干扰。
For example, on Thursday afternoons, rather than continuing with lessons, we expect the whole school to do sports.
录音说明在三个学期中的每一个学期（each of the three terms对应every term），学生们都需要制作一张海报（produce a poster）。
你可能会把后面补充提到的environment当成答案，但那只是海报具体主题的一个例子，并不是学生们要完成的作品本身。
So for each of the three terms, they are expected to produce a poster. This will normally be on something particular that they have studied that term, such as the environment.
录音直接指出每个月（every month对应each month）学生们都必须要进行考试（do tests）。
你可能会因为听到句末的year而填错，但year是指记录表现的一整年周期，测试的频率其实是每个月。
And every month, rather than the teacher giving the children a report, as I know some schools do, they have to do tests, and we record their performance over the year.
录音提到在放学后（at the end of the school day对应after school），孩子们可以去俱乐部（clubs）学习像音乐这样的新技能。
你可能会因为听到最后的music就被带偏，但这道题根据介词to，需要填的是孩子们能“去”的具体组织。
Our teachers are all very committed to the school, and at the end of the school day, many of them have set up clubs that the children go to for an extra hour to learn a new skill, such as music.
